newsitem.title: USA: Perkin-Elmer unit sues P&U unit.
newsitem.headline: Perkin-Elmer unit sues P&U unit.

text.p: A division of Perkin-Elmer Corp said Monday it had filed suit against a unit of Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc alleging infringement of several patents regarding DNA synthesis methods and processes.
PE Applied Biosystems said it filed the suit against Pharmacia Biotech of Uppsala, Sweden, in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California.
PE Applied said it believes Pharmacia Biotech manufactures and markets DNA synthesis instruments and reagents the uses of which are covered by patents owned or exclusively licensed to PE Applied.

"Although more than a dozen other companies have respected our patent position and obtained licenses under our broad licensing program, Pharmacia has refused to accept terms standard in the industry," said Dr. Michael Hunkapiller, Perkin-Elmer vice president and general manager of PE Applied.
A spokesman for Pharmacia & Upjohn said the company does not comment on pending litigation.
